title: FDIC BankFind Institution Normalizer
description: Normalize official FDIC bank institutions by certificate or state, with source dates, vintage and bounded pagination.

certificate.title: FDIC certificate
certificate.description: Exact FDIC certificate, as a string. Provide certificate or state.

state.title: State abbreviation
state.description: Two uppercase letters, for example NC.

active_only.title: Active institutions only
active_only.description: Filter the literal FDIC ACTIVE field. This is not a safety rating.

max_records.title: Maximum records
max_records.description: Stops at this cap; output flags truncated when more records exist.
